'''Biull Sangtwo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. A [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]], he ran a scam with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[RT-56/X]] whereby they would convince offworlders to purchase the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for a small fee with the intention of reselling it at a higher price. Once the deal was done, the droid would slip away and return to Sangtwo.
